correctedCritiques.pro-disagreement-not-unreality: Strongest feature: The reply precisely separates epistemological uncertainty from ontological nonexistence, deploying the scientific-disagreement analogy to decisively invalidate the inference that incomplete clarity or disagreement alone makes objective morality unreal. Principal limitation: This successful defensive demonstration neither establishes moral facts nor identifies dependable epistemic access, and it leaves unanswered whether disagreement’s extent and pattern supply probabilistic evidence against moral objectivity. Live burden: The pro case must provide affirmative grounding and explain how moral inquiry reliably discriminates authentic discovery from cultural projection, entrenched bias, evolutionary influence, and persistently conflicting intuition. Locked score: The very strong band recognizes exact scope, terminological stability, explicit qualification, decisive responsiveness, categorical-force alignment, and substantial charity, while restricting credit to defeating entailment rather than proving objectivity or divine grounding.
